name: xray_skull
description: Order a skull X-ray to evaluate bony calvarium, sella turcica, and facial bones. Used for head trauma screening, assessment of skull fractures, and shunt hardware evaluation.

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., head trauma, suspected fracture, shunt evaluation)

when_to_use: suspected skull fracture after blunt head trauma
assessment of cranial shunt or hardware position
evaluation of calvarial lytic or sclerotic lesions

examples.query: Child fell and hit head, large scalp hematoma noted

args.clinical_indication: head trauma, rule out skull fracture
